events.verdict: Brooks (PHX) is bracing for the contact from Mann (BKN) as he releases away from the contact.
Claxton (BKN) legally contests Williams' (PHX) shot attempt.
O'Neale (PHX) extends his arm into Williams (BKN) and delivers contact that is more than marginal.
Allen (PHX) establishes his right foot as his pivot foot, which he maintains after his gather.
Porter Jr. (BKN) legally contests Allen's (PHX) shot attempt.
Bouyea (PHX) dislodges the ball from Porter Jr. (BKN).
Demin (BKN) does not establish a legal guarding position in Brooks' (PHX) path prior to the contact.
O'Neale (PHX) deflects the ball away from Mann (BKN).
Mann (BKN) deflects the ball away from Williams (PHX).
Brooks (PHX) and Williams (BKN) tie up the ball and play ultimately resumes with a jump ball.

Following the tie-up between Brooks (PHX) and Williams (BKN), several players have physical and verbal interactions. Upon replay review, double technical fouls were issued to Demin (BKN) and Allen (PHX) and separately to Mann (BKN) and O'Neale (PHX), and a technical foul was issued to Porter Jr. (BKN).
Claxton (BKN) establishes himself in O'Neale's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Goodwin (PHX) legally contests Demin's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Demin's (BKN) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Wolf (BKN) is moving alongside Allen's (PHX) path as he defends the drive.
Wolf (BKN) contests Allen's (PHX) shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
O'Neale (PHX) legally contests Porter Jr.'s (BKN) jump shot attempt.
